claims.statement: EU waste law prioritizes prevention and preparing for reuse ahead of recycling and disposal.
The Waste Framework Directive set a material-recovery target for non-hazardous construction and demolition waste, supporting diversion but not proving resale demand for intact components.

contrary_evidence: Waste-hierarchy policy favors reuse, but removed products may lack certification, safe-removal economics, or a timely buyer.

economics.acquisition_route: Demolition-contractor and architect referrals, automated monitoring of public project notices, and standardized owner agreements
economics.founder_net_worth_path: Process 80 buildings by year 2 (unvalidated), expand to a national buyer-and-contractor network by year 5 (unvalidated), and exceed PLN 5 million founder equity by year 7 (unvalidated)
economics.founder_time: 12-20 hours per week during validation (unvalidated), with surveyors and removal crews delegated
economics.gross_margin_basis: No owned warehouse in the initial model; buyer-arranged collection and subcontracted surveys support 50-65% gross margin (unvalidated)
economics.payback: Project acquisition payback on the first successful auction within 2-4 months (unvalidated)
economics.pricing: PLN 2500-7000 inventory fee per building (unvalidated) plus 15-22% seller commission (unvalidated)
economics.retention_or_repeat: Repeat portfolios from demolition firms and property owners with quarterly project flow (unvalidated)

fingerprint.compounding_advantage: Exclusive early project access plus transaction data on component demand and removal costs
fingerprint.customer: Demolition clients, contractors, reclamation dealers, fit-out firms, and restoration builders
fingerprint.distribution_mechanism: Recurring demolition-contractor feeds and searchable professional-buyer alerts
fingerprint.offer_and_business_model: Pre-demolition inventory, controlled auction, and coordinated direct pickup under conditional title
fingerprint.payer_and_paid_event: Owner pays for inventory or commission is deducted when a lot is sold
fingerprint.problem_trigger: A demolition or major strip-out is scheduled and reusable assets will otherwise be crushed or expensively removed

founder_fit: Marketplace matching and valuation can be data-driven.
Acquisition can concentrate in a small recurring contractor network.
risks: Demolition schedules leave little time for transactions.
The stated PLN 100000 startup capital requirement is unvalidated.

structure.commercial_archetype: Managed B2B asset auction with pre-demolition salvage-right origination
structure.control_point: Exclusive early access and conditional title to reusable components before they enter mixed waste streams
structure.critical_dependency: Safe surveys, clear ownership, product suitability, and buyer logistics must be resolved before demolition deadlines

thesis: Sign pre-demolition first-look and conditional title agreements with owners and demolition contractors, inventory reusable doors, fixtures, timber, brick, and equipment before work begins, and auction matched lots to professional buyers. The defensible input is early contractual access to inventory; the company avoids taking waste unless appropriately permitted and transfers only items cleared for lawful reuse.
title: Salvage-First Demolition Rights Exchange
uncertainties: Which component categories have reliable price-to-removal economics?
When does an item legally become waste under Polish implementation?
